context: Across 212 reviews, the Summit 2 tent averages 4.6 out of 5. Reviewers praise the quick setup and light weight. Several say the rain fly leaks in heavy storms, and a few note that the stakes bend easily.
The Trail Runner shoes hold a 4.2 average over 180 reviews. Buyers like the grip and comfort. The most common complaint is that the sizing runs small, so many suggest ordering half a size up.
The Alpine jacket earns 4.8 from 95 reviews. Customers call it warm and windproof. A minority find it bulky, and two reviewers report a stuck main zipper.
The Daypack 24L sits at 4.4 over 140 reviews. Reviewers value the comfortable straps and many pockets. Some wish it were waterproof, and a few mention the chest clip broke.
The Down sleeping bag averages 4.5 across 160 reviews. It is praised as warm and packable. Several reviewers say it is too warm above freezing, and one reports lost down after washing.
